en:
Kaede, it's dangerous to wander around
alone, y'know?

Watch out! Keebo's standing right behind
you with a knife!

...Can it be!? Were you thinking about
killing me this whole time?

Aaaaaaaaaahhhhhhh!!!!! Someone, help
meeeee!!! She's gonna kill meeeee!!!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time running after Kokichi, who
seemed to have fun being chased.
<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi and I grew a little closer today.
